_comment: Per-area BG2 backdrop captures. BG2 tilemaps are generated by the guest at
runtime and are not present in the ROM block tables, so the extractor needs
an oracle frame for each area it should dress. Generate frames with
tools/oracle/capture_anim.py (save0 / gameplay saves work) and reference one
frame per area here. Areas without an entry keep a transparent BG2 layer.
Paths are relative to the repository root; captures/ is git-ignored.

3.note: save0 gameplay (area 3 ruins), capture_anim.py default route

2.note: save10 (late-game, Area 2 forest); frames 0..105 stapled for coverage
